# sherpa-chip

A compact input/filter chip (Figma Chip, 62:1732).

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Category | control |
| Figma | Chip |
| Source | [.ts](../../src/components/sherpa-chip/sherpa-chip.ts) · [.html](../../src/components/sherpa-chip/sherpa-chip.html) · [.css](../../src/components/sherpa-chip/sherpa-chip.css) · [.component.json](../../src/components/sherpa-chip/sherpa-chip.component.json) · [.example.json](../../src/components/sherpa-chip/sherpa-chip.example.json) |

## Example

```html
<sherpa-chip>EMEA</sherpa-chip>
<sherpa-chip data-status="success" data-dismissible>Active</sherpa-chip>
```

## Attributes

| Attribute | Values | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data-dismissible` | boolean |  | show the close button (fires chip-dismiss) |
| `data-icon` | text |  | leading icon glyph value (shown when present; or slot "icon") |
| `data-status` | `info` `success` `warning` `critical` `urgent` |  | info \| success \| warning \| critical \| urgent (via the cascade) |

## Events

Each one bubbles.

| Event | Detail |
|---|---|
| `chip-dismiss` |  |

## Slots

| Slot | Accepts | What it holds |
|---|---|---|
| `icon` | icon | a leading glyph (overrides data-icon; shown when data-icon is set) |
| (default) | text | the label |

## Parts

Style these from outside with `::part()`:

`chip`, `close`, `icon`
